articles.title: Senate Dems should accept the victory they won on Trump's crypto limits: White House
articles.snippet: U.S. Senate Democrats got President Donald Trump to accept potential limits on his lucrative crypto dealings, but they say the Clarity Act's restrictions aren't enough.

articles.title: Polymarket Account in Farage Backer's Name Took $9M in Crypto From Unknown Sources: FT
articles.snippet: The "GCottrell93" account bet the funds on Trump's election win and cashed out the profit, though who paid in and who collected is unclear.

articles.title: Clarity Act Latest Draft Bars Trump From Crypto Ventures—But Only Until 2029
articles.snippet: The long-awaited market-structure bill would block officials and their spouses from issuing digital assets and shield non-custodial developers, but the ethics ban expires in 2029 and enforcement rests solely with the DOJ.
